name: tradingview-mcp
description: TradingView toolkit for AI agents: screener, FX data, SMC/ICT scanning, chart rendering, backtesting, journal sync, Pine compile. Not affiliated with TradingView, Inc.

OANDA_API_KEY.title: OANDA API key
OANDA_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables the OANDA OHLCV provider (free practice account at oanda.com). Stored as a secret.

TV_SESSIONID.title: TradingView sessionid cookie
TV_SESSIONID.description: Optional. Enables the opt-in `session` toolset (reads data through your TradingView account - may violate TradingView's ToS). Stored as a secret.

TV_TOOLSETS.title: Enabled toolsets
TV_TOOLSETS.description: Comma list. Default = public,data. Add scan,chart,backtest,journal,strategy as needed; session/desktop/pine are opt-in and carry ToS risk.

TV_READ_ONLY.title: Read-only mode
TV_READ_ONLY.description: Set to 1 to disable all write-capable tools (hard-wins over everything).

TV_MAX_BARS.title: Max bars per response
TV_MAX_BARS.description: Hard cap on bars returned by data tools (default 5000).

TV_JOURNAL_DIR.title: FX Replay journal watch-folder
TV_JOURNAL_DIR.description: Where tv_journal_scan / tv_journal_parse read CSV exports.

TV_STRATEGY_DIR.title: Declarative strategy folder
TV_STRATEGY_DIR.description: Where tv_strategy_list / tv_strategy_run read YAML strategy specs.

TV_CDP_URL.title: TradingView Desktop CDP URL
TV_CDP_URL.description: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9223 for the opt-in `desktop` toolset.
